answer.text: React too strongly to new info, pushing prices too far

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Overreaction creates opportunities for contrarian investors — prices overshoot; mean-reversion rewards patient buyers. **The Trap:** Ignoring = underreaction (also exists, opposite effect). **Cross-Exam Context:** DeBondt-Thaler. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** DeBondt-Thaler 3-5 year reversal evidence: losers outperform winners subsequently. Classic value contrarian play.
